> An esp-32S3-based project, where I use an oled with a microcontroller, with 6 push buttons and jumper wires with battery(charging module too) . The project is going to be an archive of our own(AO3) reader, that will have the function to scroll, search specific categories and also, using the button you can toggle around the on-screen keyboard(for the search feature) and also be able to scroll specific posts. Doing it on a perfboard. Also it uses wi-fi to retrieve the posts :D

## Design

### 2026-10-01 — So I looked up literally every component needed with prices, did the prices exchanges from RON(local currency) to USD(hackclub currency) and i found these products:

**2.5h**

So I looked up literally every component needed with prices, did the prices exchanges from RON(local currency) to USD(hackclub currency) and i found these products:
-what micro controller should i use – esp32 S3 N1638
- the charging modules and charging protections i use (TP4056)
- which components i have home and which i dont
- what oled should i use
- the arduino IDE libraries needed
-found out that a perfboard is better than a breadboard since it doesnt disconnect easily
-counted the pins im gonna have on the esp32S3 and how many pins im gonna use(enough pins on the esp32 S3)
-also searched through TOO MANY WEBSITES to find a simple damn push button cheap which i don't need to buy in bulk(found one on eMAG)
-MORE RESEARCHH  :D
